questions.title: Finding Unknown Probabilities Involving Multiples of Constant k

parts.text: A discrete random variable $X$ takes values 1, 2, 3, 4 with probabilities $0.15$, $k$, $2k$, and $0.40$ respectively. Find the value of $k$ and hence find $P(X = 3)$.

questions.title: Constant in Shifted Formula and Tail Probability

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ has probability function $P(X = x) = c(x + 1)$ for $x = 0, 1, 2, 3$. Find the value of $c$ and hence find $P(X \ge 2)$.

questions.title: Distribution with Squared Outcomes and Positive Event Probability

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-2, -1, 1, 2$ only, with $P(X = x) = kx^2$. Find the value of $k$ and hence find $P(X > 0)$.
A discrete random variable $X$ takes values 1, 2, 3 with probabilities $p$, $2p$, and $3p$ respectively. Find the value of $p$ and calculate $E(X)$.

questions.title: Finding Two Unknowns from Normalization and Expectation

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values 0, 1, 2 with probabilities $0.3$, $p$, and $q$ respectively. Given that $E(X) = 1.1$, find the values of $p$ and $q$.

questions.title: Ratio of Probabilities and Expected Value with Negative Value

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-1, 0, 1$ with probabilities $p$, $0.4$, and $q$ respectively. Given that $P(X = 1) = 2P(X = -1)$, find $p$ and $q$, and calculate $E(X)$.

questions.title: Odd Integer Formula and Upper Tail Probability

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values 1, 2, 3, 4 only. Its probability distribution is given by $P(X = x) = k(2x - 1)$, where $k$ is a constant. Show that $k = \frac{1}{16}$.
Find $P(X > 2)$.

questions.title: Tail Probability Condition and Expectation Calculation

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values 0, 1, 2, 3 with probabilities $p$, $0.30$, $0.25$, and $q$ respectively. Given that $P(X \ge 2) = 0.40$, find the value of $q$ and hence find the value of $p$.
Draw up the probability distribution table for $X$, and calculate $E(X)$.

questions.title: Probability Inequality Relation and Expectation with Negative Value

parts.text: A discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-1, 0, 1, 2$ with probabilities $p$, $0.2$, $q$, and $0.3$ respectively. Given that $P(X > 0) = 3P(X < 0)$, form two equations in $p$ and $q$ and show that $p = 0.2$.
Find the value of $q$ and calculate $E(X)$.

questions.title: Simultaneous Equations from Expectation and Conditional Probability

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-1, 0, 1, 2, 3$ with probabilities $0.1$, $p$, $0.3$, $q$, and $0.1$ respectively. Given that $E(X) = 0.9$, form two equations connecting $p$ and $q$, and solve them to find the values of $p$ and $q$.
Find $P(|X| \le 1)$, and find the conditional probability $P(X > 0 \mid X \le 2)$.

questions.title: Two Constants in a Quadratic Probability Formula and Expectation

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values 1, 2, 3, 4 only, with probability function $P(X = x) = kx(x + a)$, where $a$ and $k$ are constants. Given that $P(X = 4) = 3P(X = 2)$, show that $a = 2$ and find the value of $k$.
Draw up the probability distribution table for $X$ and calculate $E(X)$.

questions.title: Symmetric Structure with Event Ratio and Expectation

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-2, -1, 0, 1, 2$ with probabilities $p$, $p$, $0.2$, $q$, and $q$ respectively. State an equation connecting $p$ and $q$ derived from the total probability axiom.
Given that $P(X \ge 0) = 3P(X < 0)$, find the values of $p$ and $q$.
Draw up the probability distribution table for $X$ and calculate $E(X)$.

questions.title: Comprehensive Unknown Distribution, Transformation, and Conditional Probability

parts.text: The discrete random variable $X$ takes values $-2, 0, 1, 3$ with probabilities $0.1$, $p$, $q$, and $0.2$ respectively. Given that $E(X) = 0.7$, write down two linear equations in $p$ and $q$, and solve them.
Draw up the probability distribution table for $X$, and find $P(X^2 \le 1)$.
Given that $X > -1$, find the conditional probability that $X$ is an odd integer.
